PKPushCredentials.doc: An object that encapsulates the device token you use to deliver push notifications to your app.

PKPushPayload.doc: An object that contains information about a received PushKit notification.

PKPushRegistry.doc: An object that requests the delivery and handles the receipt of PushKit notifications.

PKVoIPPushMetadata.doc: An object that contains metadata about a received PushKit VoIP notification.

PKPushRegistryDelegate.doc: The methods that you use to handle incoming PushKit notifications and registration events.

-initWithQueue:.doc: Creates a push registry with the specified dispatch queue.

-pushTokenForType:.doc: Retrieves the locally cached push token for the specified push type.

token.doc: A unique device token to use when sending push notifications to the current device.

type.doc: The push type constant associated with the token.

dictionaryPayload.doc: The contents of the received payload.

type.doc: The type value indicating how to interpret the payload.

delegate.doc: The delegate object that receives notifications coming from the push registry object.

desiredPushTypes.doc: Registers the push types for this push registry object.

mustReport.doc: A boolean indicating whether a VoIP app must report a call or live conversation in response to receiving this VoIP notification.
